summary.intent: Address PR review comments on cipher-box PR #296, including nitpick comments from a Copilot review and two unresolved discussion threads about key buffer sharing and folder registration safety.
summary.outcome: Fixed stale comment in ipns.service.ts, added .buffer to Uint8Array for Blob construction in TextEditorDialog.tsx, and addressed key buffer and folder registration issues in client.ts. All 57 tests passed and fixes were committed and pushed.

repo: crypto/README.md exports must be kept in sync manually when new functions are added to the package
UI-level serialization handles concurrent folder mutations, so no SDK-level locking is needed currently
TypeScript strict typing requires `as BlobPart` cast when passing `Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>` to Blob constructor
IPNS service previously referenced @cipherbox/crypto but was migrated to @cipherbox/core — stale comments can linger after package renames

code.finding: Uint8Array must use .buffer or `as BlobPart` cast when passed to Blob constructor due to TypeScript's strict BlobPart typing
createFolder was sharing folderKey buffer with background re-wrap operations; ensureFolderRegistered could register unloaded folders with empty keys — both required defensive fixes
Had stale comment referencing @cipherbox/crypto instead of @cipherbox/core after package migration

workflow: GitHub review thread replies and resolutions can be batched via CLI in a single pass after all fixes are applied
Running tsc --noEmit across all packages before committing catches type errors that tests may not surface
Copilot nitpick reviews may partially overlap with already-resolved threads — checking review IDs against prior work avoids duplicate fixes

friction: Fetching the correct nitpick review required multiple gh API calls because the review ID from the URL didn't directly surface all comments in the first query
TypeScript rejected Uint8Array passed directly to Blob, requiring an extra fix not in the original review comments
ipns.service.ts stale comment turned out to already be fixed in a prior commit, causing unnecessary read/edit attempts
open_items: Concurrent folder mutations: UI-level serialization is a stopgap — architectural improvement to handle this at the SDK level was explicitly deferred as a follow-up
ensureFolderRegistered registering unloaded folders with empty keys may need a broader audit of other folder registration call sites beyond the two fixed in this session
